concept.title: The Default access group
concept.shortdesc: The Default access group is provided by Red Hat on the Hybrid Cloud Console. It contains a set of roles that are predefined in the Hybrid Cloud Console. The Default access group includes all authenticated users in your organization.

conbody.p: The Default access group contains a subset of all predefined roles. The Default access group is automatically updated when Default access group roles are added in the Hybrid Cloud Console.

As an Organization Administrator, you can add roles to and remove roles from the Default access group. When you do so, its name changes to Custom default access group. The changes you make to this group affect all authenticated users in your organization.
